seo.title: eBay Magical Listing: a genAI product listing from a photo - 30% of sellers (2023)
seo.meta_description: eBay's Magical Listing generates a listing's title and description from a photo. 30% of US app sellers tried it, and more than 95% kept the AI description.
seo.resume_citable: With Magical Listing (2023), eBay generates a complete product listing from a photo: 30% of US app sellers tried it and more than 95% of them used the AI-generated description.

faq.a: From a photo, eBay's AI generates a title, description, category, and attributes, and suggests price and shipping.
30% of US app sellers tried it at least once and more than 95% used the generated description.

pattern: GenAI generation of a product listing from a photo
objectif_business: Reduce listing friction, especially for beginner sellers facing the cold-start problem, by automatically generating a complete listing.
description: The Magical Listing tool generates a listing from a single photo taken or uploaded in the eBay app. The AI analyzes the image and produces a title, description, release date, category, and subcategory, and combines with eBay's other components to suggest price and shipping. The seller reviews and edits before publishing. The direct goal: speed up the creation of detailed, consistent listings, especially for new sellers. Rolled out from late 2023 in the Seller Hub and the mobile app.
points_cles: GenAI generation of a product listing from a single photo, with seller review.
The Magical Listing tool, eBay's in-house vision and LLM models in the Seller Hub.
30% of US app sellers tried it, more than 95% kept the AI description.

resultats.metrique: US app sellers who tried the tool at least once
Sellers who kept the AI description, with or without edits

niveau_preuve.justification: Adoption and retention metrics communicated by eBay and reported by specialized press (Retail Dive, TechCrunch). Usage figures at marketplace scale, but no direct financial result.

stack_technique.detail: Recognize the object in the photo and generate title, description, category, and attributes; eBay does not publicly detail the models.
Magical Listing's entry points: photo taken or uploaded, then reviewed and edited by the seller before publishing.
Existing eBay components combined with the generation: category and subcategory mapping, price and shipping suggestions.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: On demand, every time a seller creates a listing.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The eBay platform (in-house); the seller stays in the loop to validate.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The photo quality and object recognition. On a poorly framed or hard-to-identify product, the generated listing goes off and the seller has to redo everything.

etapes.detail: The seller photographs or uploads an image of the product in the app.
The AI recognizes the object and generates title, description, category, and attributes.
The platform suggests price and shipping from its other components.
The seller edits if needed then publishes the listing.

replication.premiere_etape: Wire a multimodal model into the listing creation flow and let the seller edit the output.

playbook.action: Frame the fields to generate (title, description, category, attributes) and the target taxonomy.
playbook.livrable: A spec for the generated listing and sets of test photos

playbook.action: Wire a multimodal model (API) into the listing creation flow.
playbook.livrable: A photo-to-listing prototype on the test catalog

playbook.action: Build the mapping to the taxonomy and the seller review screen.
playbook.livrable: An editable pre-filled listing in pre-production

playbook.action: Open a beta to a segment of sellers and measure trial and description retention.
playbook.livrable: Adoption and retention figures on the beta

playbook.action: Generalize and track listing completeness and time to list.
playbook.livrable: The feature in production with an adoption dashboard

replication.equipe: 2 devs + 1 PM + 1 data profile for the taxonomy and output evaluation.

statut_vivant.note: Feature permanently integrated into the Seller Hub and the app; eBay keeps extending its genAI seller tools (official Selling with AI page).

transposable_ue.note: A global platform with EU sellers. Generating listings from a photo processes product images, not sensitive personal data. The AI Act requires transparency about generated content, which remains compatible with an assisted, seller-editable listing.
